## State / SharedState

`State()` returns in-process state (local to the current process).  
`SharedState()` returns storage-backed state intended for prefork/multi-process sharing.

```go title="Signature"
func (app *App) State() *State
func (app *App) SharedState() *SharedState
```

See [State Management](./state.md) for usage and examples.

#### Config fields

| Property                                                                              | Type                                                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default                                                                |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| <Reference id="appname">AppName</Reference>                                           | `string`                                                        | Sets the application name, which is shown in the startup message, passed to the [`OnListen`](./hooks.md#onlisten) hooks as `ListenData.AppName`, and used in the default [`SharedState`](./state.md#sharedstate-prefork-safe) key prefix. It does not set the `Server` header; use `ServerHeader` for that.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `""`                                                                   |
| <Reference id="bodylimit">BodyLimit</Reference>                                       | `int`                                                           | Sets the maximum allowed size for a request body. Zero or negative values fall back to the default limit, `fiber.DefaultBodyLimit`. If the size exceeds the configured limit, it sends `413 - Request Entity Too Large` response. This limit also applies when running Fiber through the adaptor middleware from `net/http`, when decoding compressed request bodies via [`Ctx.Body()`](./ctx.md#body), when parsing multipart form data via [`Ctx.MultipartForm()`](./ctx.md#multipartform), and when copying an uploaded file with [`Ctx.SaveFileToStorage()`](./ctx.md#savefiletostorage).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `4 * 1024 * 1024`                                                      |

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
